title: pinus clusiana subsp. mauretanica
intro: Pinus clusiana subsp. mauretanica, commonly known as Moroccan Atlas Pine, is a subspecies of pine tree native to the mountainous regions of Morocco. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pinus clusiana subsp. mauretanica include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
